rv.q: The entire off-its-rocker off-Broadway show, whose sole sin is occasionally trying too hard, is lovably loony.
From start to finish, all of the above occurs at a non-stop pace, directed by playwright Zak according to what seems like his conviction that he alone knows precisely the property’s demands.
The jokes and references all zoom by — which is perhaps just as well given that the percentage of punchlines that actually hit the funny bone is relatively low. (Your smileage may vary.)
